submitted.rationale: Only 3 merit measurements were available, so I targeted the Fe-V-rich, Ni-poor corner, where FeVO4-type phases are expected to be the photoactive absorbers under 3.2 eV light. Index 34 (Fe0.39 Ni0.18 V0.42), which is close to 1:1 Fe:V, gave the highest photocurrent (2.8 µA). A more Fe-rich point (158) and a more V-rich point (94) were both lower, so the local maximum is near Fe:V ≈ 1.

rejected.reason: V-rich beyond FeVO4 stoichiometry: measured 1.87 µA, lower than 34
Ni oxides/vanadates are expected to be poor photoanode absorbers; not worth spending the 3-measurement budget there
